style.styleTitle: Homcom Set of 2 4ft Pre-Lit Aspen Fir Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Enhance your entryway or living space with this set of 2 pre-lit Aspen Fir artificial Christmas trees anchored in decorative pot bases. Featuring realistic molded PE outer foliage and dense PVC inner tips, each tree offers 11 dual-colour lighting modes via remote control—allowing adjustments without getting up. Battery powered, they bring safe, symmetrical charm for young and fluffy friends. . Set of 2 Aspen Fir trees anchored in golden decorative pot bases provides a balanced, symmetrical accent; . Molded PE outer tips capture the true texture and natural look of real evergreen boughs, complemented with Inner PVC foliage for dense and full foliage; . Pre-lit LEDs feature 11 dynamic lighting functions switching between warm white and multicolour; . 5m remote control allows you change lighting modes without getting up; . Cordless and compact size design offer placement flexibility away from power outlets and small spaces; . PVC leaves and strong steel trunk ensure home fire safety; . Molded PE tips naturally retain their shape, requiring minimal manual tip shaping; . Sectioned trunk structure for space-saving storage.
